استكرهوا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْرَهُوا (istakrahū) /is.tak.ra.huː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# اُسْتُكْرِهُوا (ustukrihū) /us.tuk.ri.huː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# اِسْتَكْرِهُوا (istakrihū) /is.tak.ri.huː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
